content.value_statement: Inconsistent colors and fonts make presentations and documents look unfinished. This skill provides curated themes and a selection process for consistent styling.
actual_capabilities: Presents ten named preset themes with documented use cases.
Defines color palettes with hex values for each preset theme.
Specifies header and body font pairings for each preset theme.
Guides users through choosing a theme before applying it.
Can create a custom theme from user-provided direction.
Applies selected colors and fonts across slides, documents, reports, or landing pages.
limitations: It supplies theme guidance, not a full design review of every slide.
It depends on the host tool to edit files and render fonts correctly.
The PDF showcase is a reference asset and should not be modified.
Custom themes still need user review for brand compliance.

use_cases.title: Polish Client Slide Decks
use_cases.description: Apply consistent colors and fonts to consulting decks before client delivery.

use_cases.title: Style Product Launch Assets
use_cases.description: Choose a theme for launch decks, landing pages, and supporting reports.

use_cases.title: Create a Lightweight Brand Look
use_cases.description: Generate a custom theme when a team lacks formal design guidelines.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a Preset Theme
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single artifact.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the theme showcase, then help me apply one preset theme to this slide deck after I choose it.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Theme Options
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for theme selection support.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare three themes that fit a professional finance report, then recommend one with a short reason.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Custom Theme
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request when presets do not fit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a custom theme for a clean healthcare presentation using calm colors and highly readable fonts.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt a Theme Across Assets
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for multiple artifact types.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply one theme consistently across my slide deck, executive summary, and landing page draft.

output_examples.input: A software launch deck needs a modern visual direction.
output: Use electric blue for primary accents and neon cyan for highlights.
Use dark gray backgrounds with white text for strong contrast.

output_examples.input: A sustainability report needs a grounded and natural look.
output: Use forest green for section headers and ivory for readable backgrounds.
Use sage and olive for charts, dividers, and secondary emphasis.

output_examples.input: No preset theme matches a luxury wellness brand.
output_examples.output: A custom theme would define a calm palette, paired fonts, usage notes, and review steps before application.

best_practices: Review the showcase before selecting a theme.
Confirm the chosen theme before applying changes.
Check contrast and readability after styling each artifact.
anti_patterns: Do not mix multiple preset themes in one artifact.
Do not modify the showcase PDF as part of normal use.
Do not apply colors without checking legibility on final backgrounds.

faq.question: What artifacts can this skill style?
faq.answer: It can guide styling for slides, documents, reports, and HTML landing pages.

faq.question: How many preset themes are included?
faq.answer: It includes ten preset themes with colors, fonts, and suggested use cases.

faq.question: Can it create a new theme?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create a custom theme from user goals, audience, and style direction.

faq.question: Does it edit the showcase PDF?
faq.answer: No. The showcase PDF is only a visual reference for theme selection.

faq.question: Does it include exact color values?
faq.answer: Yes. Each theme file lists named colors with hex values.

faq.question: Will it enforce brand rules automatically?
faq.answer: No. Users should review custom and preset themes against their brand guidelines.
